'''Keith Watabayashi''' (DeckTech handle '''Gen''')<ref name="dt-26273">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26273 The other TIGIH at Deciphercon], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 17 November 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26273/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/26273/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009001845/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26273/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]] list from Day 2 of the [[2002 World Championship]], which he and [[Brad Reinhold]] played. He also posted a [[Dark]] [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum]] list (''G-Scum'').<ref name="dt-26425">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26425 G-Scum], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 29 November 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26425/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/26425/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009013207/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26425/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
